entities.name: Danitha Capashen
entities.description: A Benalish Knight, daughter of Aron Capashen and leader of House Capashen and the Benalish army.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: A captain and distant relative of Danitha.

entities.name: Aron Capashen
entities.description: Danitha's father and head of House Capashen; captured and compleated by Phyrexians, killed by Danitha.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: Enemy of Benalia in constant war.

entities.description: Asked Danitha to join the new Weatherlight crew.

entities.description: Danitha's younger brother who joined the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Battle of the Mana Rig
entities.description: A battle Danitha was present at.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A demon whose right hand Danitha is in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Legacy Curse
entities.description: A curse afflicting the Capashen bloodline, broken by Raff.

events.summary: Danitha refuses Jhoira's request to join the new Weatherlight crew; Raff goes in her stead.
events.quote: Danitha refused Jhoira 's request to become part of the new Weatherlight crew

events.summary: Danitha leads the rescue of her captured father with Jaya and Ajani.
events.quote: she led the effort to rescue him with Jaya Ballard and Ajani Goldmane

events.summary: Aron is revealed compleated; Danitha kills him and becomes leader of House Capashen.
events.quote: Danitha killed him and assumed his role as leader of House Capashen

events.summary: In the Echoverse Danitha becomes Belzenlok's right hand and leads his forces against Benalia.
events.quote: Danitha has taken up her father's role as the right hand of Belzenlok

events.summary: Josu Vess strikes Danitha with Whisper's blade at Blighted Fields; she and Raf feel the Legacy Curse.
events.quote: Josu struck her with Whisper 's blade

events.summary: After Whisper is defeated and Josu destroyed, Raf breaks the Legacy Curse with Whisper's dagger.
events.quote: Raf was able to use Whisper's dagger to break the curse afflicting the Capashen bloodline
